answer: Admission is rationed by a quadratic deposit tied to funding trails: the first identity from a source stakes 25 POA, the second 100, the third 225, each locked for 14 epochs and released only after 10 verified tasks over 5 epochs. Funding trails are traced like a vine back to a single root, so linked copies cannot pose as strangers. A failed spot audit forfeits the deposit and resets the queue, so a flood of cheap copies drowns in an ocean of rising cost before reaching voting strength, while an honest agent pays once and earns an ivory seal after its tasks verify.
